references.title: The Forgotten Wau: Preserving the Tradition
references.access_level: Publisher metadata and the full text were checked.

references.access_level: The published text was checked through a public copy; the direct publisher page returned HTTP 403.

references.title: AI-Enabled Chatbot for Preserving and Promoting Kuching Cultural Heritage
references.verified_citation: Cheah, W. S., Yeow, L. Z., de Boer, V., Ben Yahia, S., Lu, M., & Chai, K. S. (2026). AI-enabled chatbot for preserving and promoting Kuching cultural heritage. International Journal on Informatics Visualization, 10(3), 1176–1183. https://doi.org/10.62527/joiv.10.3.4557
references.scholar_check: Direct Scholar query blocked; no Scholar record retrieved. Primary publisher and institutional records verified. Non-retrieval does not establish non-indexing.

references.title: Leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Culturally Inclusive Hakka Chatbots: Design Insights and User Perceptions
references.venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Recent Advances in Systems Science and Engineering (RASSE)
references.access_level: Conference metadata were checked through the authors’ institution; the full author manuscript arXiv:2410.15572v1 was examined.
references.use: Discuss cultural resource curation, question routing, translation and response difficulties in a Hakka chatbot.
references.limit: Its evaluation uses SUS in a Taiwanese context. It does not establish Wau accuracy or learning gains, and the allocation of evaluation stages has reporting limits.

references.title: CulturalBench: A Robust, Diverse, and Challenging Cultural Benchmark by Human-AI CulturalTeaming

references.title: Having Beer after Prayer? Measuring Cultural Bias in Large Language Models

references.limit: The tests are in Arabic and balance Arab and Western entities. They do not evaluate Malaysia or the proposed chatbot.

references.title: Strong hallucinations from negation and how to fix them

references.use: Justify explicit checking of negation and claim polarity in representation and testing.
references.limit: The negation and reasoning experiments do not validate WauTrace logic and did not examine full text generation in depth.
references.section: Materials and methods; answer policy rationale

references.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
references.access_level: ICLR metadata and the Google Research abstract were checked. OpenReview presented a verification barrier; the PDF was not read.
references.use: Justify distinguishing insufficient available evidence from explicit negation and from failure to use sufficient evidence.
references.limit: The findings concern RAG models and datasets. They do not establish performance of this deterministic system. A DOI was not verified.

references.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
references.access_level: The ACL record, full text and appendix on evaluation limitations were examined.
references.use: Distinguish answer correctness from citation support and justify checking whether each claim is supported by its cited page.
references.limit: Automated ALCE metrics have limitations for partial support. Citation success alone does not establish answer usefulness or historical correctness.

references.use: Organise comparisons of educational purposes, interfaces and roles using a review of 36 studies.
references.limit: This is a literature review, not an experiment establishing learning gains for WauTrace.

references.title: Chatbots applications in education: A systematic review
references.access_level: Authors’ institutional metadata and the abstract were checked; the full text was not read.
references.use: Support the background on educational chatbot applications through a review of 53 studies, limited to claims supported by the abstract.
references.limit: Do not transfer pooled study results to this project or attribute unread methodological details to the paper.

references.title: Knowledge Graphs
references.access_level: Only authors’ institutional metadata and the abstract were examined.
references.use: Support general concepts of entities, relations and structured knowledge representation.
references.limit: The citation does not imply implementation of an enterprise knowledge graph or all reviewed techniques. This implementation uses a small semantic network.

references.title: Usability testing of a healthcare chatbot: Can we use conventional methods to assess conversational user interfaces?
references.venue: Proceedings of the European Conference on Cognitive Ergonomics (ECCE 2019), 207–214
references.access_level: The supplied CUQ guide was examined and the original source metadata were verified through the authors’ institution. No claim is made that the full paper was read.
references.use: Cite the origin of CUQ and its 16-item scoring equation as the primary instrument reference.
references.limit: Its context is healthcare. Adapted wording does not automatically inherit instrument validity. This is a foundational exception to the recent-reference window.

references.title: Towards Validating a Chatbot Usability Scale
references.venue: Design, User Experience, and Usability; HCII 2023; Lecture Notes in Computer Science 14033, 321–339; Springer
references.access_level: Publisher metadata, abstract and the Ulster University record were checked; the full text was not read.
references.use: Add a recent reference on chatbot usability scale validation while distinguishing participants from repeated responses.
references.limit: The study includes 26 people and 156 repeated responses. It does not validate the present adapted wording or establish a universal success threshold.

references.title: “It Hasn’t Lived in Our Society”: Investigating Cultural Sensitivity in LLM Chatbots for Emotional Support
references.venue: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’26), 20 pages
references.access_level: The supplied full paper was examined. Its title, year and DOI were verified against its first page.
references.use: Support specifying cultural context, using local knowledge and evaluating user interaction.
references.limit: The context is emotional support among 21 young Saudi women. It does not establish Wau heritage accuracy, learning effects or clinical psychological validity.
